result.summary: Identified 3 issues involving placeholder content and minor layout inconsistencies.

issues.description: Listings use generic vector illustrations instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Update listings with real menu item photos to improve app credibility.

issues.description: The 'All' category button's dark fill creates excessive visual contrast against adjacent elements.
issues.suggestion: Use a more subtle color for the active filter state.

issues.description: Vertical spacing between restaurant carousels and section headers is tight.
issues.suggestion: Increase margin-bottom on headers to improve section separation.
